page.layout: One printed page: one column of text, with a running head and page number at the top; a heading "Paraphrasis." centred within the text; signature "B 2" at the foot. Left margin holds cropped fragments of a neighbouring page (show-through and edge, not transcribed).

main_text.p: Philosophicis viretis, credulum illud & sequax ovile: Et sicut Senfus olim, adipati cliens Epicuri, ridiculam suos asseclas devolvit in foveam, dum meridiano Sole, orientem occidentemque Solem, majorem fateri cogit, quia majorem oculi testarentur: Ita & hi pudendis æquè quos ducunt, imo turpioribus circumveniunt modis, nisi frontem illaqueatis perfricuisset publicus ille ganeo & corruptor, Mos.
main_text.head: Paraphrasis.
main_text.p: Horum in Cimmeria Republica tam potentium patronorum clientes, cum se sentiant Genii

page.notes: The first word "Philosophicis" is at the start of the column; the drop capital H of "Horum" is a large woodcut initial joined to "orum" (transcribed as "Horum"). Printed text reads "Genii" at the line end, continuing on the next page. Some letters in the running head and body are slightly blurred; "viretis" and "testarentur" read as printed. Marginal fragments on the left belong to the neighbouring page and are not transcribed.
